{{Top|leg}}
'''Catapult pressors''' were a type of [[tractor pressor]] incorporated into the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of a [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. Using the same [[Pressor field|repulsion]] technology, they were used to increase acceleration for the launching of one-man [[Starfighter/Legends|fightercraft]].
